headline: Tokyo Core Inflation Rises to 2.9%, Boosting Bank of Japan Rate Hike Case
summary: Tokyo's core consumer price index rose 2.9% in November from a year earlier, reaching its highest level since July 2025 and bolstering expectations for a Bank of Japan interest rate hike.
why: Higher inflation in Tokyo acts as a leading indicator for nationwide Japanese trends, heavily influencing the Bank of Japan's monetary policy decisions and interest rate trajectory.

impacts.name: Nikkei 225
impacts.why: Accelerating inflation increases the likelihood of a BOJ rate hike, which impacts broader Japanese equity valuations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Faster-than-expected core inflation in Tokyo strengthens the case for a near-term Bank of Japan interest rate hike, increasing borrowing cost concerns.
